overall.verdict: The mobile dark variant of xln wallet demonstrates excellent design execution with strong adherence to the premium dark aesthetic and visceral value principles. The one-scale bar visualization is particularly well-implemented and understandable. Typography, color usage, and data legibility are outstanding. The design successfully balances information density with clarity, creating a trustworthy and professional fintech experience.
